ledger: hand and numbered blocks | hand holds green block '2' beside another green block '2' at 00:00 | eight blocks lined up in a row with hand resting on the second block at 00:09 | pulling a single block repeatedly causes it to split into multiple new blocks from 00:01 to 00:07

findings.description: Pulling a block rightward repeatedly causes new blocks to spawn and split off from existing blocks rather than simply moving the grabbed block.
The hand exhibits discontinuous, choppy motion as it jumps from the rightmost block back to the center blocks.
